suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require established BPH before incident CKD; separately assess urinary obstruction, BPH treatment exposure, baseline renal disease, hypertension, diabetes, age, and other renal causes. Population-level prospective association only; BPH medication may contribute and end-stage kidney disease estimates were less precise. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH) and Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
